title: SPARTA: A Sparse Ternary LLM Accelerator with Adaptive Attention and Unified Datapath for Long-Context Edge Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.34824v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: LLMs on edge devices are constrained by limited memory and bandwidth. Although 1.58-bit ternary weights greatly reduce model storage, long-context inference is increasingly bottlenecked by KV-cache traffic and attention. Existing accelerators also use separate datapaths for ternary linear layers and attention, incurring hardware and execution overhead. We present SPARTA, a sparse ternary LLM accelerator for efficient long-context edge inference. SPARTA integrates: (1) a phase-aware sparse dataflow exploiting heterogeneous sparsity across compute-bound prefill and memory-bound decode; (2) a unified compute fabric mapping ternary SpMM/SpMV and bit-serial attention onto shared processing elements to exploit zero-weight and zero-bit sparsity; and (3) an adaptive two-stage attention engine combining page-level Top-k selection to reduce K-cache accesses with token-level Top-p pruning to reduce V-cache traffic. SPARTA reduces KV traffic by 4.

translated_title: SPARTA：一种用于长上下文边缘推理的具备自适应注意力与统一数据通路的稀疏三值LLM加速器
translated_abstract: 边缘设备上的大语言模型受限于有限的内存和带宽。尽管1.58比特三值权重极大地降低了模型存储需求，但长上下文推理日益受到KV缓存流量和注意力计算的瓶颈制约。现有加速器还为三值线性层和注意力计算采用独立的数据通路，带来了硬件和执行开销。我们提出了SPARTA，一种面向高效长上下文边缘推理的稀疏三值LLM加速器。SPARTA集成了：（1）相位感知的稀疏数据流，在计算受限的预填充阶段与内存受限的解码阶段利用异构稀疏性；（2）统一的计算架构，将三值SpMM/SpMV与位串行注意力映射到共享的处理单元上，以利用零权重和零比特稀疏性；（3）自适应两阶段注意力引擎，结合页级Top-k选择（减少K缓存访问）与令牌级Top-p剪枝（减少V缓存流量）。SPARTA将KV缓存流量降低了4……（原文摘要至此处被截断）
tldr: SPARTA是一种面向边缘设备长上下文推理的稀疏三值LLM加速器，通过相位感知稀疏数据流、统一计算架构和自适应两阶段注意力引擎（页级Top-k与令牌级Top-p剪枝），显著降低KV缓存流量并提升推理效率。
en_tdlr: SPARTA is a sparse ternary LLM accelerator for long-context edge inference that integrates phase-aware sparse dataflow, a unified compute fabric for ternary linear layers and bit-serial attention, and an adaptive two-stage attention engine combining page-level Top-k selection with token-level Top-p pruning to drastically reduce KV-cache traffic.
